posts.trend: Daughter's school admission cancelled after paying Rs 21,000 admission fee; refund denied despite no class
posts.context: Getting a toddler into an urban school requires parents to undergo a corporate recruitment process.
posts.angle: Nursery admissions have adopted the exact vocabulary of corporate hiring, right down to the ghosting.
slides: Your three-year-old needs a CV more impressive than your corporate manager.

"What is your parenting philosophy?"
"Where do you see them in fifteen years?"
"Can you explain this gap in their playtime?"
"Please transfer the interaction fee."

They reject the child.

Your husband is still on the waiting list.
posts.caption: Someone you know is drafting a cover letter for a toddler right now. 📝
posts.rank_verdict: The post lacks a concrete, checkable specificity detail like a exact rupee fee or a specific brand to ground the exaggeration.
